name: Topgrade
summary: Upgrades everything at once: pacman and AUR packages, Flatpak, cargo, pip, npm, shell plugins and more
description: Topgrade detects the package managers and tools you use and runs each one's update command in a single pass, so you are not keeping a shell one-liner of upgrades in sync. On Omarchy that means pacman and yay, plus Flatpak, Rust crates, Python and Node tools, Neovim plugins, oh-my-zsh and fish plugins, Firmware via fwupd, and many others. Steps can be disabled or customised in a TOML config.
